summary: 7 film announcements, 8 TV announcements across 5 trades.

film.title: Happy Old Year
film.announcement: Netflix is adapting 'Happy Old Year' from author Marcelo Rubens Paiva (known for 'I'm Still Here') as a series.

film.title: Baton
film.announcement: Major League Soccer has boarded Danny Ramirez's soccer drama 'Baton' as a key partner on the project.

film.title: Burger Night: Luli, Magda & Lore
film.announcement: Eli Roth-executive produced 'Burger Night: Luli, Magda & Lore' gets an all-female cast.

film.title: Untitled Jacques Audiard Horror Film
film.announcement: Director Jacques Audiard reunites with Netflix for a new horror film.

film.title: Untitled Matt Damon/The Daniels Sci-Fi Film
film.announcement: Matt Damon describes his role in The Daniels' new sci-fi movie as 'The Breakfast Club' meets 'Inception' meets anime meets John Oliver.

film.title: Ebenezer
film.announcement: First trailer released for Ti West's 'Ebenezer' starring Johnny Depp.

film.title: Weapons Prequel
film.announcement: Zach Cregger teases a 'Weapons' prequel with a 'crazy' approach to Gladys' origin story.

tv.title: Blade Runner 2099
tv.announcement: Sequel series sets late fall Prime Video premiere with first trailer unveiled at Comic-Con.

tv.title: Kabul
tv.announcement: BBC buys 'Kabul' drama series about American withdrawal from Afghanistan starring the late Eric Dane.

tv.title: Cross
tv.announcement: Robin Givens joins Prime Video's 'Cross' as an intellectual conservative senator for Season 3.

tv.title: Thunder Road
tv.announcement: Devon Allman lands his first major acting role in AMC's NASCAR drama 'Thunder Road'.

tv.title: Spain World Cup Docuseries
tv.announcement: Prime Video secures a docuseries about Spain's World Cup triumph.

tv.title: The Secret Of Secrets
tv.announcement: Carlton Cuse discusses his Netflix series 'The Secret Of Secrets' amid conversation about sports rights and residuals.

tv.title: Monster: The Ed Gein Story
tv.talent: Ian Brennan (showrunner), Charlie Hunnam, Laurie Metcalf
tv.announcement: Ian Brennan showrunner discusses the series about Ed Gein with cast including Charlie Hunnam and Laurie Metcalf.

tv.title: Somebody Feed Phil Season 9
tv.announcement: Phil Rosenthal's 'Somebody Feed Phil' releases a special Max and Helen's episode on YouTube ahead of Season 9 premiere.
